result.brief: 提出可扩展模态专家库与模态感知视觉 tokenizer 的医学视觉-语言预训练方法，通过掩码预训练与对比对齐学习并增量扩展表征。
result.reason: Medical vision-language pretraining with modality-aware visual tokenizer targets for masked pretraining and expandable expert bank; representation contribution but domain-specific, no video/world-model evidence.
